resources.string: Living forms at different depths, shaped by evolving Game of Life frequency fields.
Lets Koiros\'s dots collide with the apps on your home screen.

Koiros reads where your home screen\'s apps, folders and widgets sit, so the wallpaper\'s dots can bounce off them. It reads your launcher\'s window only, keeps only the shapes and positions, and discards names and all other content at once. Nothing is stored or sent: Koiros has no internet access.
